key_insight: UNICON is a foundation model that learns predictive relations from numerical context and generalizes them across scientific and social domains, including unseen disciplines.
engineering_relevance: It suggests a scalable way to build cross-domain surrogate and inference systems that can transfer across problems without retraining.
method: Uses graph-based examples as in-context demonstrations to infer the underlying relation.
Applies the inferred operator to queries from the same system.
Combines with language-model agents to improve performance further.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that UNICON approaches specialist performance across multiple scientific and social systems, and can surpass state-of-the-art specialists in an unseen discipline when paired with language-model agents.
watch_item: Generalization depends on the diversity of the training corpus, so performance may degrade in domains far from the training distribution or with weak contextual examples.
paper_title: A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization
